note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; routes, seats and labels are as supplied and carry no legal meaning. No preset states who may attend, any rule or any outcome. Coordinator decision (standing stress rule, 2026-09-26): the long-labels-stress count is capped to the baseline's four people; see that preset's description for the measurements.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Generic building and room with two separate supplied routes from the same entrance hall: two people use the restricted route as configured and two the public route; each walks through their door to their seat and sits, and their label appears as they land.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: five people, three on the public route and two on the restricted route as configured, reaching both rows; a different building and room, and the last person still waiting in the corridor in the final state.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Near-maximum text lengths (~50-character seat labels, long route, legend, key and note texts); the count is capped at the baseline's four people on four separated seats under the standing stress rule (coordinator decision 2026-09-26, AUTHORING item 20). Measured at 1080x1080 with six people (four on the two front tables): with every chip kept off every route line (drawn or still to be walked) two table labels stay unplaced at every size down to 16.9 px; five people (one bench pair) leave two unplaced at 16.9 px. With four people every ratio places every label strictly (1:1 at 17.7 px).
